name: Fabrication Core
desc: There is no line between this colony's population and its industrial plant. Whole strata of the hive are given over to fabricator-forms that wake in rotation, extruding the heavy machinery that drives the swarm's mines, smelters, and shipyards. Silencing this organ - even briefly - starves every industry that feeds on its output. The hive defends its heart above all else.

name: Swarm Nexus
desc: The colony's war-strata: growth-vats and command lattices where Defense Swarms are fabricated and expeditions are assembled and launched. Every armed hull this world fields passes through the nexus. Silence it - a raid will do - and the colony fabricates no new defenders and stages no expeditions until it recovers; the swarms already grown fight on, but nothing replaces them.

name: Ground Defenses
desc: A dispersed lattice of weapon growths and semi-autonomous combat frames, extruded by the fabrication strata and woven through the terrain. No garrison mans it and no marines quarter here: its inputs are heavy machinery and metals, and a hive starved of either defends itself poorly.

name: Heavy Batteries
desc: Continent-spanning accelerator batteries grown directly into the planetary crust, aimed and fired by the hive as a single organism. Fed on heavy machinery and metals rather than crews and shells - starve the hive's industry and the batteries slacken with it.
